definitions.evidenceResolution: Returned provenance resolved through source/raw citation routes when a vault is supplied. Legacy outputs without provenance are unavailable.
definitions.aggregation: Macro means over evaluated non-null metrics; inspect coverage, missing ground truth and per-question failures.
